observation: Captured via corrected precompileProbe hook on ship_drifter (draws 31/31/31, radius 10.73, size 13.58 x 11.75 x 11.75 WU, 0 errors). buildMultirole (+X forward) pairs an 8-sided tapered fuselage cylinder (mul:fus) and 8-sided noseConeGeo with twin pylon-mounted side cylinders (mul:nacelle0), flat winglets (mul:winglet), and recessedCanopy. Explicit lod2 was not captured.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — oversized bubble recessedCanopy wider than the 8-sided mul:fus cylinder, detached floating engineProp, flat-capped primitive mul:nacelle0 cylinders, and protruding nose:panel/ship:dish attachments.
next: Size recessedCanopy within the fuselage beam, bevel/detail mul:nacelle0 intake and exhaust caps, flush-mount engineProp and ship:dish, seat decals/blinkers on the hull, verify lod2, and recapture.
